purpose: Restore the historical single-seed Amazon exploratory baseline comparison with bounded Development calibration and three metadata-selected new K2 requests.
prior_evidence: Stage18 and Stage19 have already been inspected. This follow-up is specified afterwards and is not a fresh holdout or independent cross-seed validation.
new_request_selection: Exclude all Stage18/19 requested users, then take the first three low/middle pairs in the existing metadata hash order, with two adaptation exposures and at least five Development samples per user.
selection_rule: One configuration per baseline minimizes equally weighted K2/K4 mean absolute counterfactual error subject to both requests passing AUC damage <= 0.005 and LogLoss damage <= 0.01, finite predictions and no collapse. Ties use compute count then candidate id.
attention_fit: RecEraser fits attention on a frozen Development subset excluding all calibration and comparison requested users. All selection and comparison metrics use the disjoint common Dev-Select subset.
all_reporting: Retain all candidates, failures, selections and all three requests. If no eligible configuration exists, mark the method NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE and additionally evaluate the lowest-error finite candidate as an explicitly ineligible diagnostic; do not describe it as calibrated-successful.
